title: Scrolling to set time is frustrating on touchpads
line: A short touchpad swipe over the Timer widget's digits now changes the time by a few steps instead of jumping by tens of minutes.
explanation: TimerEdit changed a digit by one step for every wheel event whose angleDelta was above 5, ignoring its size. Touchpads send many small events per swipe, so a short swipe added 20+ minutes and setting an exact time was nearly impossible. The digit now accumulates angleDelta and changes once per 120 units (one wheel notch), the same as a mouse wheel.

commits.message:
applets/timer: accumulate scroll deltas before changing a digit

Every scroll event over a digit changed it by one step, so a short swipe
on a touchpad, which sends many tiny events, made the time jump by tens
of minutes. Now deltas add up and a digit moves once per wheel notch.

BUG: 397841

patches.diff:
From 444b44098060a014696a7ab333bdc0eb0f66447f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:27:54 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/timer: accumulate scroll deltas before changing a
 digit

Every scroll event over a digit changed it by one step, so a short swipe
on a touchpad, which sends many tiny events, made the time jump by tens
of minutes. Now deltas add up and a digit moves once per wheel notch.

BUG: 397841
---
 applets/timer/TimerEdit.qml | 10 +++++++---
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/timer/TimerEdit.qml b/applets/timer/TimerEdit.qml
index 44cf0e893..d5925314b 100644
--- a/applets/timer/TimerEdit.qml
+++ b/applets/timer/TimerEdit.qml
@@ -37,7 +37,7 @@ Row {
             id: digitSvg
             property int meaning
             property int num
-            readonly property int mouseWheelAngleThreshold: 5
+            property int wheelDelta: 0
             width: internal.digitW
             height: internal.digitH
 
@@ -82,11 +82,15 @@ Row {
 
                 onWheel: wheel => {
                     wheel.accepted = true
-                    if (wheel.angleDelta.y > digitSvg.mouseWheelAngleThreshold) {
+                    digitSvg.wheelDelta += wheel.angleDelta.y
+                    while (digitSvg.wheelDelta >= 120) {
+                        digitSvg.wheelDelta -= 120
                         if (timerEdit.value + digitSvg.meaning < 24*60*60) {
                             timerEdit.digitModified(digitSvg.meaning)
                         }
-                    } else if (wheel.angleDelta.y < -digitSvg.mouseWheelAngleThreshold) {
+                    }
+                    while (digitSvg.wheelDelta <= -120) {
+                        digitSvg.wheelDelta += 120
                         if (timerEdit.value - digitSvg.meaning >= 0) {
                             timerEdit.digitModified(-digitSvg.meaning)
                         }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: a short touchpad-like swipe (20 events of 1 px) over the minutes sets 21 minutes
With the fix: the same swipe sets 3 minutes
Master: one mouse wheel notch over the seconds adds 1 second
With the fix: one wheel notch still adds exactly 1 second

review.text: Addresses the cause: every wheel event above 5 units counted as a full step regardless of size, so touchpad swipes overshot. Accumulating angleDelta and stepping per 120 units is the standard Qt/Plasma pattern and leaves mouse-wheel behaviour unchanged, as the verification shows (20 px swipe 21 -> 3 minutes, one notch still +1).
